environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on internal warehouse network. Flask app runs directly via gunicorn behind an nginx reverse proxy configured only for TLS termination and static asset caching. No query inspection or filtering middleware. The /api/v2/parts/search endpoint is exposed to all authenticated network clients (warehouse terminals, mobile scanners). Network access controlled only by WPA2-Enterprise on the warehouse WiFi segment.

config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with proxy_pass only, no ModSecurity or lua inspection
config.network: VLAN 40, accessible from warehouse terminals and office subnet
config.database: SQLite 3.42 with WAL mode, file permissions 0644
config.auth: No query-level auth on GET endpoints, HMAC only on POST
